questions_and_answers.question_text: What is the literal meaning of mǎshang?
What is the literal meaning of chàbuduō?
Give three other translations of chàbuduō.
Write the Chinese for "I'll come to your office right away."
Write the Chinese for "It is nearly eight o'clock."
Write the Chinese for "I'll be there in about half an hour."
Write the Chinese for "That school has approximately three hundred students."

answers.answer_text: Nèige xuéxiào yǒu chàbuduō sānbǎige xuésheng.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Where does chàbuduō stand in relation to the amount?

articles.text:
7. A: Xíng.                          That will be fine.
   A: Wǒ mǎshang dào nín bàngōng-    I'll come to your office right away.
      shì lái.
   A: Chàbuduō bànge zhōngtóu jiù    I'll be there in about half an hour.
      dào.

Notes on No. 7

The adverb mǎshang (literally, "on horseback") means "immediately," "right away."

Chàbuduō may be translated fairly literally as "does not differ much." Other translations are "about," "approximately," "almost."

Chàbuduō bādiǎn le.              It is nearly eight o'clock.
Zhèiběn shū wǒ chàbuduō          I have almost finished reading this
kànwán le.                       book.
Tāmen chàbuduō bādiǎn zhōng      They are coming at around eight
lái.                             o'clock.
Nèige xuéxiào yǒu chàbuduō       That school has approximately three
sānbǎige xuésheng.               hundred students.
